description: SCHC whole-packet compression vectors (RFC 8724). 'packet' is the full uncompressed IPv6 datagram; 'compressed' is compress_packet(packet). Round-trip: compress(packet) == compressed and decompress(compressed) == packet.

vectors.name: coap_linklocal
vectors.description: Link-local IPv6+UDP+CoAP GET

vectors.name: coap_linklocal_computed_zero_checksum
vectors.description: Link-local IPv6+UDP+CoAP GET whose true UDP checksum computes to zero: the wire field is 0xFFFF (RFC 768 computed-zero encoding) and decompression must reconstruct 0xFFFF, never the illegal 0x0000.

vectors.name: coap_global
vectors.description: Global IPv6+UDP+CoAP GET

vectors.name: icmpv6_echo
vectors.description: Link-local ICMPv6 Echo Request

vectors.name: icmpv6_echo_reply
vectors.description: Link-local ICMPv6 Echo Reply exercises the second Echo discriminator value carried verbatim in the residue

vectors.name: rpl_dio
vectors.description: Link-local RPL DIO

vectors.name: rpl_dao
vectors.description: Link-local RPL DAO with DODAGID

vectors.name: oscore_linklocal
vectors.description: Link-local IPv6+UDP+OSCORE CoAP

vectors.name: oscore_global
vectors.description: Global IPv6+UDP+OSCORE CoAP (Yggdrasil 0200::/8)

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_source_port_linklocal
vectors.description: Rule 7 source-only port 10883 with canonical fe80::/64 IID mode

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_empty_payload_linklocal
vectors.description: Rule 7 source-only port 10883 with an empty MQTT-SN payload

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_destination_port_linklocal
vectors.description: Rule 7 destination-only port 10883 with PortDirection one

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_both_ports_linklocal
vectors.description: Rule 7 both-port canonical form uses PortDirection zero

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_global_full_addresses
vectors.description: Rule 7 global endpoints use two full 128-bit addresses

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_mixed_full_addresses
vectors.description: Rule 7 mixed link-local/global endpoints use full-address mode

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_traffic_class_nonmatch
vectors.description: A valid MQTT-SN packet with nonzero Traffic Class does not match Rule 7 and is preserved by Rule 255.

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_flow_label_nonmatch
vectors.description: A valid MQTT-SN packet with nonzero Flow Label does not match Rule 7 and is preserved by Rule 255.

vectors.name: coap_traffic_class_nonmatch
vectors.description: Rule 0 elides zero Traffic Class, so a valid nonzero value falls back unchanged.

vectors.name: coap_flow_label_nonmatch
vectors.description: Rule 0 elides zero Flow Label, so a valid nonzero value falls back unchanged.

vectors.name: coap_version_nonmatch
vectors.description: A UDP payload with CoAP Version 2 is not normalized to Version 1 by Rule 0.

vectors.name: coap_reserved_tkl_nonmatch
vectors.description: Reserved CoAP TKL 9 is not treated as a compressible Rule 0 header.

vectors.name: coap_truncated_token_nonmatch
vectors.description: A CoAP TKL 8 header with only two token octets is not compressed or repaired.

vectors.name: linklocal_noncanonical_slash64_fallback
vectors.description: fe80:0:0:1::/64 is within fe80::/10 but cannot use IID-only Rules 0/5 and round-trips unchanged via Rule 255.

vectors.name: rpl_dio_flags_nonmatch
vectors.description: Rule 3 elides zero RPL.flags (EQUAL), so a valid DIO with flags 0x01 falls back unchanged.

vectors.name: rpl_dao_no_dodagid_nonmatch
vectors.description: Rule 4 requires the DAO D flag (bit 6) and DODAGID, so a valid D-flag-clear DAO falls back unchanged.

vectors.name: srh3_in_transit_udp_fallback
vectors.description: An in-transit uncompressed RPL RH3 (type 3, segments_left 1) with the UDP checksum computed over the RFC 2460 section 8.1 final destination does not match any compression rule and is preserved by Rule 255.

vectors.name: routing_type0_malformed
vectors.description: A packet carrying the RFC 5095-deprecated Routing type 0 is rejected rather than forwarded under Rule 255.

vectors.name: srh3_segments_left_overflow_malformed
vectors.description: An RPL RH3 whose segments-left exceeds its address count is rejected.

vectors.name: ipv6_fragment_header_malformed
vectors.description: An IPv6 Fragment header is unsupported (LICHEN fragments at the SCHC layer) and is rejected.

vectors.name: srh3_outer_dst_checksum_malformed
vectors.description: An in-transit RPL RH3 whose UDP checksum was computed over the outer destination instead of the RFC 2460 section 8.1 final destination is rejected.

vectors.name: ext_header_udp_length_mismatch_malformed
vectors.description: A Routing-header-led packet whose UDP length field (8) disagrees with the bytes present (12) is rejected.

vectors.name: hbh_udp_bad_checksum_malformed
vectors.description: A Hop-by-Hop-led UDP packet with a garbage checksum is rejected; the ext-header chain does not bypass UDP validation.

vectors.name: udp_zero_checksum_malformed
vectors.description: A plain UDP datagram on non-SCHC ports with a wire checksum of zero is rejected; computed-zero serializes as 0xFFFF.

vectors.name: non_ipv6_short_input_malformed
vectors.description: Input shorter than an IPv6 header is not a packet: compress must reject it, never emit Rule255-wrapped garbage that Rust/Python peers fatal on at decode_rule255.

vectors.name: non_ipv6_version4_input_malformed
vectors.description: A version-4 buffer is not an IPv6 packet: compress must reject it like the Python and Rust references, never emit Rule255-wrapped bytes.

vectors.name: rh3_reserved_octets_malformed
vectors.description: An RPL RH3 with nonzero Reserved octets 6-7 (after CmprI/CmprE/Pad, which are zero) violates RFC 6554 s3 and is rejected despite a valid checksum over the final address.

vectors.name: rh3_noncanonical_hdr_ext_len_malformed
vectors.description: An RPL RH3 with Hdr Ext Len 3 (one address plus eight trailing octets) is not expressible when CmprI=CmprE=Pad=0 (RFC 6554 s3 requires HEL=2n) and is rejected; the checksum was computed over the last 16 bytes the pre-tightening code would have used.

vectors.name: srh3_two_address_in_transit_udp_fallback
vectors.description: A canonical two-address in-transit RPL RH3 (HEL=4 = 2n, CmprI=CmprE=Pad=0, Reserved zero, segments_left 1) with the UDP checksum over the last address (RFC 2460 s8.1) round-trips byte-preserving under Rule 255 - pins the multi-address accept path of the RH3 canonical-length policy.

vectors.name: coap_invalid_udp_checksum
vectors.description: A plaintext CoAP packet with a corrupted mandatory IPv6 UDP checksum is rejected rather than repaired.

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_profile_size_exact_maximum
vectors.description: A canonical 21-byte link-local Rule 7 prefix plus 22533 payload octets is the exact 22554-byte encoded SCHC profile maximum; decompression reconstructs 22581 raw IPv6 bytes.

vectors.name: mqtt_sn_profile_size_one_over
vectors.description: One additional Rule 7 payload octet produces a 22555-byte encoded SCHC packet and must be rejected before checksum or output allocation.

vectors.name: icmpv6_echo_truncated_residue
vectors.description: A Rule 2 packet one octet short of its 22-byte residue must be rejected before any reconstruction.

vectors.name: rpl_dio_truncated_residue
vectors.description: A Rule 3 packet one octet short of its 39-byte residue must be rejected before any reconstruction.

vectors.name: rpl_dao_truncated_residue
vectors.description: A Rule 4 packet one octet short of its 36-byte residue must be rejected before any reconstruction.

vectors.name: rule255_multicast_scope15_destination_malformed
vectors.description: Reserved-scope multicast destination is invalid on a transmitted link

vectors.description: Multicast source with zero UDP checksum (structure and address both invalid)

vectors.name: rule255_dual_defect_loopback_source_bad_checksum_malformed
vectors.description: Loopback source with corrupt UDP checksum (structure and address both invalid)
